highlights: Massive UI Overhaul with 3-Way Navigation, Command Palette & Stability Fixes
changes: 3-Way Navigation System: Switch seamlessly between Rail + Panel, Top Navigation Bar, and Orbital Navigation modes with per-user saved preferences
Global Command Palette: Instant keyboard-driven navigation and quick actions across all GateBill modules
Refreshed Design System: Overhauled Topbar, DataTable, SideDrawer, forms, and responsive mobile/dark-mode polish across the application
Customer Portal Subscription Usage Fix: Resolved 404 error when fetching usage for unlimited plans with NULL FUP limits
Internet Suppliers Balance Polish: Cleaner prepaid credit formatting (no leading '+' sign) and prominent light-red badges for negative owed balances
Build & Database Scripts: Improved embedded migrations staging in build_embed.bat and squashed schema initialization
